name: @grasp-os/core
description: The core Worker: sign-in, knowledge, Apps, workflows, model gateway, audit log

scripts.dev: vp -C ../web build --mode development && vp run build && node ../connect/build.ts && node ../../scripts/d1-local-migrations.ts --persist-to "${DEV_PERSIST_TO:-.wrangler/state}" -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../connect/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../connect/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to "${DEV_PERSIST_TO:-.wrangler/state}" --var DEV_SKIP_ROUTER_SECRET:true --var DURABLE_OBJECT_JURISDICTION:none --var RUNTIME_PROFILE:workerd --var SANDBOX_IN_PROCESS:unbounded
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply KNOWLEDGE --remote
scripts.db:generate: drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/core/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/workspace/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/audit-log/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/onboarding/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/model-ledger/drizzle.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config src/db/data-store/drizzle.config.ts
